svg.title: A Deliver task, step by step
svg.desc: Animated walkthrough of an AE Deliver task. The Harness orients the task. An edit attempted before the plan is locked is denied by the host hook. The Engineer writes the plan and the Harness locks it and grants the implement gate. The Engineer works, independent reviewers assess the diff, and ae verify runs the named checks. A failing check sends the task back to work; after repair and fresh review the checks pass on the final bytes. The Engineer decides what the task taught, the Harness stores it, and the report carries the evidence.
svg.text: A Deliver task, step by step
You ask the Engineer for an outcome. A change runs in Deliver mode.
The Harness orients the task: a small context pack of specs, plans and past learnings.
An edit before the plan is locked? The host hook denies it.
The Engineer writes the plan. The Harness locks it and records a hash of each spec.
Plan locked, implement gate granted. Now edits inside the scope are allowed.
The Engineer edits within the plan scope and runs focused tests as it goes.
Independent reviewers assess the exact diff. The author never reviews itself.
ae verify runs the named checks. One fails, so the task is not done.
Back to work. A failing or missing check is never a pass.
The diff changed, so the old review is stale. Review runs again.
Checks pass on the final bytes. The evidence is bound to them.
The Engineer decides what the task taught. The Harness stores it outside your repo.
The report carries the evidence. The next task starts with what this one learned.
Orient, lock intent, gate, work, review, verify, compound, report. A failing check sends the task back to work.
